modules.name: Yeno’s Orbit Tablet Support
modules.author: Yeno
modules.description: Tablet edition for Tablet 3:2 screens: the whole player is scaled up and the sky fills the screen. Your music in orbit. A circular cover ringed by a visualizer that glows brighter as the song plays, a progress arc with a glowing moon, a twinkling starfield, a live seek bar and controls on frosted glass. v2.0: make it yours - 6 colour themes, 4 visualizer rings, sky, seek bar, controls, title and lyrics styles, spinning cover, song change animations, background variants, plus the queue bar and audio format badge. New: galaxy, black hole, deep nebula and aurora backgrounds. Tap the artist name or the song title to open their page. Top and bottom padding sliders fit the player to any screen.
